description: Aries decan 1 (March 21 to March 30): personality, love, work and growth, with Mars as sub-ruler of the first ten degrees of Aries.
answer: In Western astrology, the first decan of Aries covers 0° to 9° of the sign, roughly March 21 to March 30, with Mars as its sub-ruler, the sign's own planet. It is read as pioneering drive in its purest, most impatient form. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Aries decan 1 personality
paragraphs: The first ten degrees of Aries open the whole zodiac, and astrologers have long treated this slice as the starting gun itself. Mars is the sign's planet and also the sub-ruler here, so nothing dilutes the message: move first, think on the way. People with the Sun in this decan are often described as direct to the point of bluntness, physically restless and quick to volunteer for whatever nobody else wants to try. There is an innocence to it as well. The first-decan Ram rarely schemes, because scheming takes too long, and what you see is very nearly what you get.

Doubling Mars intensifies both the gifts and the friction. Courage arrives without much internal debate, which makes these natives useful in a crisis and occasionally exhausting in a committee. Traditional texts link this decan with heat, speed and the head, and modern readers tend to translate that into a temper that flares and fades within minutes. Grudges are uncommon; boredom is the real enemy. Because the sub-ruler offers no softer planet to lean on, the work of pacing, listening and finishing usually has to be learned deliberately rather than absorbed. When it is, the raw spark becomes a dependable engine.

sections.heading: Aries decan 1 in love and at work
paragraphs: Romance with a first-decan Aries tends to begin with a clear, unmistakable move rather than months of hints. They like to know where they stand and assume a partner does too, so ambiguity can feel like rejection to them. Shared activity often matters more than long talks: a hike, a game, a spontaneous trip. Arguments can be loud and over quickly. What helps most is a partner who stays steady without going cold, and who treats honest disagreement as a sign of closeness. Learning to ask how the other person is, and then waiting for the answer, is a quiet act of love here.

At work this decan is usually happiest at the beginning of things: launches, pitches, first drafts, new territory. Ownership motivates far more than instruction, and a vague brief with a tight deadline can bring out their best. Long consultation cycles and layered approval chains tend to drain them. Roles in emergency response, sport, start-ups, sales or any field that rewards decisive action often suit the temperament. The useful habit is pairing up with a colleague who loves the middle and end of projects, so ideas reach completion instead of being abandoned for the next shiny challenge.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Aries decan 1: what Mars adds
paragraphs: The first decan covers 0° to 9° of Aries, which in most years means birthdays from March 21 to March 30. First decans take the sign's own ruler, so Mars rules both the sign and this decan, which is why it is often called the purest expression of Aries. The other two decans of Aries belong to the Sun (decan 2) and Jupiter (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Mars adds drive, courage and a readiness to compete. A Mars decan is commonly read as more direct and physical, impatient with delay, energised by a challenge and willing to start fights that others would rather avoid. Martial decans are often linked with sport, competition, enterprise and protective instincts, and their usual lesson is to choose battles worth winning. Here Mars doubles up with the sign's own ruler, so Aries's courage, initiative, directness and a restless urge to begin come through with little filtering.

sections.heading: Growth for Aries decan 1
paragraphs: The main growth edge for this decan is the gap between impulse and action. Try building a short, deliberate pause into decisions that affect other people, even ten minutes or one night. Notice which conflicts were really about speed rather than substance. Physical outlets matter, because unspent Mars energy often leaks out as irritability, so regular hard exercise can be more than a hobby. Practise finishing one modest project completely before starting another. Asking for input early, rather than presenting finished decisions, tends to turn potential critics into allies.

Within Aries, decan 2 leans towards martial courage warmed by the sun's pride and generosity and decan 3 leans towards restless fire reaching for distant horizons and bigger meanings. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Why is the first decan of Aries called the most typical Aries?
faq.answer: Because Mars acts as both the sign ruler and the sub-ruler of the first decan, no other planet colours it. Astrologers therefore read these degrees as Aries undiluted: direct, brave, impatient and energised by beginnings, with fewer of the softer or broader tones found later in the sign.

faq.question: What are the dates of Aries decan 1?
faq.answer: In most years March 21 to March 30, the days when the Sun is between 0° and 9° of Aries. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Aries decan 1?
faq.answer: Mars. In the triplicity system each fire sign's decans take the rulers of the fire signs in order, starting with Aries's own ruler, Mars.
